description: Verify that echoUTF16DYNAMIC odd-before-termination — DUT must reject or ignore
approach:
[Objective]
An odd byte before the null terminator breaks UTF-16's 2-byte unit invariant — DUT must reject (no walk-back applies here).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
